content:
Hello! I was checking something in driver/android/binder and noticed that the driver declare two submodules in a different way, the node module with the node.rs file and the range_alloc module with the range_alloc/mod.rs. I could not find something related to how to declare modules in the docs [1]

I have a couple of questions:

  1. Does it make sense to send a patch changing one of the submodules to the other format to keep the driver's code consistent?
  2. Does the project prefers one over the other? Which one?
  3. If 2. is yes, would it make sense to create a GH issue (marked as good first issue) to move from one format to the other?
  4. Would it make sense to create a section in the documentation [1] to communicate which way is preferred by the project?

If 3 or 4 are a yes, I would not mind doing them

Thanks!

[1] https://docs.kernel.org/rust/coding-guidelines.html
It's historical. The range_alloc module was a directory from the very start, but node started out as one file and got a sub-module later.
I don't think we should rename files unless there's a good reason to do so (e.g. avoiding have duplicate entries in MAINTAINERS file)
Nothing to do then, thank you both!
